name: Massmore_MomoJoy
description: BLE HID gamepad host for ESP32 / ESP32-S3 on the Arduino core 3.x. Scans, bonds, parses the HID Report Map at runtime and decodes any BLE gamepad into a normalised state (sticks -512..511, triggers 0..1023). Made for the Massmore MOMO Joystick Controller SKU-1001.
keywords: ble, hid, host, gamepad, joystick, esp32, esp32-s3, nimble, robot, massmore, momo
